subject: Hospitality
title: Private Dining and Breakout Spaces
description: A fast breakdown of Private Dining and Breakout Spaces for builders.

hook.text: Private dining rooms in hotels generate 3–5x higher per-cover revenue than main dining rooms. Exclusivity commands a premium.

buildup.text: These spaces serve corporate dinners, celebrations, and VIP events. They combine food service with privacy and prestige.

discovery.text: Flexible design matters: movable walls, adjustable lighting, and modular furniture let one room serve groups of 8 or 80.

twist.text: Post-pandemic, private spaces gained new appeal. Guests wanted intimate gatherings away from crowded public areas.

climax.text: Hotels are adding more bookable micro-spaces: pods for calls, rooms for meetings, and nooks for private meals.

punchline.text: Smaller spaces, higher per-hour value. Exclusivity is the new square footage.

quiz.question: How much more revenue do private dining rooms generate vs. main dining rooms?
